0001000001.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on NASDAQ under the symbol SWS.

Synthetic Workflow Systems provides a cloud workflow automation platform. Our workflow automation platform enables customers to design, execute, and monitor their business processes entirely in software.
Customers configure automated approval, reporting, and integration workflows without writing code; the platform executes these workflows and delivers the completed outputs.
Substantially all of our revenue is derived from subscriptions to the workflow platform.

0001000002.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on the NYSE under the symbol ALL.

Adaptive Learning Labs operates an adaptive digital learning service. Learners submit questions through our application and receive individualized step-by-step explanations and practice materials generated by our adaptive engine.
The service adapts each explanation and practice set to the learner's submitted work and progress history.
Subscriptions to the adaptive learning service represent the substantial majority of our revenue, alongside a smaller print workbook business.

0001000003.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on the NYSE under the symbol MDA.
Customers query, combine, monitor, and analyze market data through our analytics workstation to support investment decisions.
The workstation combines licensed market data feeds with our proprietary analytics models.
Data terminal subscriptions account for substantially all of our revenue.

0001000004.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on NASDAQ under the symbol PRS.
Merchants use our platform to authorize, route, settle, and reconcile electronic payments.
Our certified connections to card networks and banking rails execute each transaction under applicable regulatory permissions.
Payment processing fees represent substantially all of our revenue.

0001000005.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on the NYSE under the symbol RLN.
The RideLink platform connects riders with independent drivers and facilitates payment for completed trips.
Drivers use the partner application to accept trip requests; riders request transportation through the consumer application.
Ridesharing bookings represent substantially all of our revenue.

0001000006.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on NASDAQ under the symbol SVM.
Subscribers stream our licensed and produced films and series across connected devices.
The service provides streaming playback, member profiles, and recommendations across supported devices.
Streaming subscriptions represent substantially all of our revenue.

0001000007.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on the NYSE under the symbol SSH.
Our platform enables members to share updates, follow other members, and interact with community content; advertising on the platform generates substantially all of our revenue.
Advertisers purchase targeted campaigns delivered within member feeds.

0001000008.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on NASDAQ under the symbol PFI.
Players purchase and participate in interactive entertainment worlds and online multiplayer experiences built on our proprietary game engine.
We publish premium and free-to-play titles supported by in-game purchases.
Game sales and in-game purchases represent substantially all of our revenue.

0001000009.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on the NYSE under the symbol CPS.
Our consultants design, implement, and operate client technology systems using our internal delivery accelerators.

Engagements are staffed by consulting teams and delivered under time-and-materials or fixed-fee contracts. Clients review deliverables and engagement status through our client portal, while the deliverables themselves are produced by our consulting teams.
Professional services fees represent substantially all of our revenue.

0001000010.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on the NYSE under the symbol MSD.
The MediSense device and its embedded software continuously monitor patients and adjust treatment delivery.
Each system pairs an implantable monitoring device with embedded control software and a clinician dashboard.
Device system sales and related software represent substantially all of our revenue.

0001000011.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on NASDAQ under the symbol OCR.
We operate two reportable segments: OmniCloud, a subscription business software segment, and OmniRetail, a physical retail and logistics segment.
OmniCloud customers use our hosted applications to manage inventory, orders, and accounting; the retail segment sells general merchandise through stores and fulfillment centers.
The retail segment generates the majority of consolidated revenue; the OmniCloud segment is material and reported separately.

0001000012.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on the NYSE under the symbol AGT.
We provide integrated agronomy services, farm supplies, and the AgriPlan software used by growers to plan and monitor field operations.
AgriPlan subscriptions are sold together with agronomy engagements and supply contracts.
Software, supplies, and services revenue are managed and reported as a single integrated segment.

0001000015.text: Our innovative cloud platform empowers customers to accelerate digital transformation.

0001000016.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on NASDAQ under the symbol TLC.
We provide scheduling software for field service teams.
In 2023 we launched an AI assistant that plans field service routes automatically.

0001000017.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on NASDAQ under the symbol RNC.
Renamed Corp, formerly Oldname Corp, provides design software used by engineering teams to create and validate component models.
The design suite generates validated component models and manufacturing drawings directly from engineer specifications.
Software subscriptions represent substantially all of our revenue.

0001000018.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on the NYSE under the symbol ADI.
Our compliance software automates the preparation, validation, and filing of regulatory reports for customers.
Customers upload source records and the software assembles, validates, and files each required regulatory report.
Compliance software subscriptions represent the majority of our revenue, alongside a smaller advisory practice.

0001000020.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on the NYSE under the symbol NPM.
We manufacture industrial pumps and compressors. We deploy artificial intelligence and proprietary software throughout our manufacturing operations.
Our products are engineered pumps, compressors, and replacement parts sold to industrial customers.

0001000021.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on NASDAQ under the symbol SHF.
Customers use our mobile application and website to purchase household products and track delivery.
We source, warehouse, and deliver household products from our regional fulfillment centers.
Product sales represent substantially all of our revenue.

0001000022.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on the NYSE under the symbol SWH.
We produce flat-rolled steel products for automotive and construction customers.
Products include hot-rolled coil, cold-rolled sheet, and coated steel sold by the ton.

0001000023.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on NASDAQ under the symbol CBH.
The bank provides deposit, lending, and treasury services to consumers and small businesses through branches and an online banking portal.
Net interest income from loans and deposits represents the substantial majority of revenue.

0001000024.text: Annual report pursuant to Section 13. Common stock listed on the NYSE under the symbol PBD.
We provide contract drilling services for onshore oil and natural gas wells.
Drilling rigs and crews are contracted to exploration and production operators on a dayrate basis.
